summary: This note describes Don Quixote, the eighth original studio album by Canadian singer Gordon Lightfoot. It was released in 1972 on Reprise Records and reached number 42 on the Billboard album chart.
one_line: Gordon Lightfoot's 1972 eighth original album Don Quixote, released on Reprise Records, which peaked at number 42 on the Billboard album chart.
key_facts: Don Quixote is an album by Canadian singer Gordon Lightfoot.
Don Quixote is Gordon Lightfoot's 8th original album.
Don Quixote was released on the Reprise Records label.
Don Quixote reached #42 on the Billboard album chart.
